chunks: And whatever is in it from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdullah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from al-Hakam ibn Miskin, from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr al-Ahwal al-Kufi.

key_terms.الْأَحْوَلِ: A descriptive epithet used as part of the narrator’s identification.
key_terms.رَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ: A supplicatory honorific meaning 'may Allah be pleased with him.'

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which al-Ṣadūq transmits reports from ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It also briefly identifies ʿAbd al-Malik ibn ʿAmr al-Ahwal al-Kufi as an Arab, making the entry primarily a transmission-note and biographical notice.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: And whatever is narrated from Abd Al-Malik ibn Amr, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Saʿd ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khaṭṭab, from Al-Hakam ibn Miskin, from Abd Al-Malik ibn Amr Al-Ahwal Al-Kufi,
